name: native-reason-manifest-memory
goal: Retain only reason-relevant manifest declarations across source history

evidence: Historical reason sides still retain every active full ComponentManifest although requiredReasons uses only unit identity, status, source paths and declared configuration digest.
test/history-reason-steps.e2e.test.ts asserts compact side and source-file facts but does not inspect manifest shape; extend its 32-revision scenario to require compact reason manifests.
The 32-revision scenario failed on cf81ce11b0c193a9e966774edcd29e08147ca0c5 because historical manifests retain fields beyond declarationHash, id, owns and status.
